motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Color, background, and border transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared filled action with restrained rounding.
components.html: Conheca a plataforma →
components.css: .ds-button {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:54px;padding:16px 28px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease;} .ds-button:active {transform:translateY(1px);} .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}} .ds-primary{background:var(--color-brand);color:var(--color-brand-ink);} .ds-primary:hover{background:var(--color-brand-hover);}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:54px;padding:16px 28px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease;} .ds-button:active {transform:translateY(1px);} .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}} .ds-secondary{border-color:var(--color-border-strong);color:var(--color-text-bright);background:transparent;} .ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--color-surface);}

narrative.overview:
Editorial, precise, and restrained: the real product leads the presentation.
Large typography, open spacing, quiet dark surfaces, and authentic interface
captures give the security platform a clear and inspectable presence.

Components are precise and restrained, with softened corners and clear actions.
Depth comes primarily from tonal surfaces and dividing lines, with isolated
shadows on internal pages. These descriptions were confirmed by the owner on
2026-10-30; they describe the existing website rather than a replacement design.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite surfaces with a restrained signal accent.
Manrope for narrative and JetBrains Mono for technical labels.
Generous editorial spacing and strong typographic hierarchy.
Real product imagery with visible provenance captions.

rules.name: The Effective Token Rule
rules.body:
Use the final theme values recorded above, not
the superseded neon turquoise and navy definitions earlier in the stylesheet.

dos: Do use the effective theme tokens and the self-hosted font families.
Do preserve real captures, their proportions, captions, and full-size access.
Do use typography, spacing, and quiet dividers to establish hierarchy.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and mobile navigation.
donts: Don't revive superseded theme values by extracting only the first CSS block.
Don't treat colors inside product screenshots as website tokens.
Don't spread local glow or legacy hover colors across unrelated components.
Don't invent input, chip, or modal patterns that the website does not contain.
